_doc: Per conversion pair slug (e.g. heic-to-jpg), value is an array of { "q": "question", "a": "answer" }. Plain text in answers; optional markdown links [label](https://noclaudkit.com/...) or [/relative/path] rendered as <a> in HTML and plain label in FAQPage JSON-LD. Missing slug or empty array: no FAQ section and no FAQPage JSON-LD.
